scope: Input-selected four-source/RGGB/three-condition CPU diagnostic. Same fixed V101 weights and noisy/target arrays; multiply conditioning shot/read and variance, not actual simulated noise. Four predefined strengths. Native160/exposure1, exact synthetic GT. Full12 baseline scores and PNGs must replay; ADC cases must remain identical. Not full427/camera proof, model training, automatic recommendation or production policy change.
native_findings: ISO100 variants look close. Lower prior retains more high-noise fur/canopy detail and grain; stronger prior smooths further. Additional GT-projected band energy coexists with more off-target energy. No global free-detail improvement or real-camera claim.
